tasks.label: Yamtrack: start dev stack
tasks.detail: Runs web, Celery and Tailwind from the Procfile via honcho
tasks.command: if [ "$REMOTE_CONTAINERS" = "true" ]; then uvx honcho -e /dev/null start; else echo 'Not in the dev container; skipping. Run uvx honcho -e /dev/null start manually.'; fi

windows.command: Write-Host 'Open the folder in the dev container to auto-start Yamtrack.'
